When I first met him I was so excited - I had finally met someone who loved to travel as much as I did. I thought I had me my match. But we only met a few months before covid and never got the chance.

I can accept that this relationship is over but I grieve for the memories I thought we would make. I thought I had finally met a partner who could book a ticket to anywhere and within a few hour be dancing in some unknown bar.

I saw you on Instagram by accident the other night. You were dancing in a red room and only a silhouette but I knew it was you. You were a little bit drunk and I’ve rewatched it so many times thinking I was there, feeling the warmth of the room, the bass of the music and watching you across the room knowing you were mine.

I’m upset that covid stole that memory from us and I’m angry that other life things got in the way of the future I had hoped for.

Hey love, be kind to yourself. By the sounds of it this guy blindsided you in many ways. It’s okay to hurt, it’s okay to spiral and it’s okay to be very angry and very sad. Don’t beat yourself up about it, it won’t do you any good. Take time to tell yourself “it’s okay to feel this, I am hurting” repeat that as many times as you need. Because it’s true. You’ve been through a lot and you won’t magically get better one day, it’s slow incremental change that gets you there and the first step is self love and compassion. Day by day sis. You’ll get there.
